description: Without signing in: the macro and earnings schedule for a date range (event, date and time in US Eastern, and the session for earnings), without estimates, results or moves. Signed in with a free QuantGeeks account: the same. With a QuantGeeks plan: the same plus the estimate and actual, the surprise, the straddle-implied move and the actual move. US macro releases, company earnings and SEC filings for a date range, chronological, at most 40 rows (`detail` 'all' lifts the cap), times in US Eastern (earnings by session: before open, during, after close). Default: today through the end of next week; at most 21 days. Filter with kind (macro, earnings, filings) and symbols (earnings and filings for those tickers). A plan adds EPS and revenue estimate against actual, the surprise, the straddle-implied move before the print, the actual move, and who the straddle paid. The answer carries an attribution (a data credit, CC BY-SA 4.0): pass it along when you share the data. For forward option positioning into a print use quantgeeks_get_expiration_map.

detail.description: 'summary' (default): the first 40 rows; 'all': every row in the range.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern). Default: today.

symbols.description: Only earnings and filings for these tickers, e.g. ["NVDA","AAPL"].

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the end of next week; the range is at most 21 days.

name: quantgeeks_get_earnings_calendar
title: Earnings and macro calendar
